items.text: $HD Online sales were 16.6 percent of Q2 net sales in the 10-Q and rose 11.0 percent from a year earlier. That figure does not include HD Supply or SRS though. items.author: KryptonResearch14
items.text: $HD Primary made 6,592 million dollars of operating income in Q2 in the 10-Q, about 15 percent of its sales. Other, the SRS distribution side with GMS in it, made 247 million on 5,055 million of sales, just under 5 percent. Over six months Other operating income actually fell, 263 million against 288 million a year earlier, even with all that acquired sales growth in there.
